notes.title: Update 1.3 Is Now Available + Serbian Language
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33634139/6a95ed2c7fc2cf2f0d0ffac267aaca53ad8a48d8.png

Hi everyone, Dymchick1 is here!

Thank you @Caelliox for your Serbian
Unfortunately, there is no option to change the language to Serbian in Steam. To change game language to Serbian, open the console (`) and input "ls set ser"

Update 1.3 is now live. 
• Added new time point (check point) after you complete leverage section
• Added new hidden achievement "Hi, Time Traveler"
• Added effects in the caves near souls
• Increased spike's trap delay and increased the size of wooden platforms (it's easier to pass now)
• Added missing localization (and improved)

If you find a bug or have suggestions or want to help with translation, join with discord server.
MOMO.EXE DISCORD SERVER

Enjoy the game!
